description:
*The Sirah of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ* by **Shaykh Dr. Yasir Qadhi** is an English transcript of his 101-part Seerah Series, presenting the life and mission of the Prophet ﷺ from the setting of pre-Islamic Arabia through the Makkan and Madinan periods. The lectures explore the events of the Prophetic biography, their historical context, and the lessons they offer for faith, character, and community life. This edition arranges the transcript into topical chapters, bringing together discussions that continue across video boundaries and preserving the transcript’s explanatory footnotes.

Shaykh Dr. Yasir Qadhi is a Muslim scholar, author, and educator whose training combines traditional Islamic studies with academic research. After earning a degree in chemical engineering from the University of Houston, he studied at the Islamic University of Madinah, completing a bachelor’s degree specializing in hadith and a master’s degree in Islamic theology. He subsequently earned a PhD in Religious Studies from Yale University. His teaching, books, and lectures make Islamic scholarship accessible to English-speaking audiences. [Biographical source: Miftaah Institute](https://www.miftaah.org/instructors/shaykh-yasir-qadhi).

The videos were transcribed by **Muhammad Abdul Rahman**. We gratefully acknowledge his considerable time, care, and hard work in transcribing the series and making these lessons available in written form. As the transcriber’s introductory note explains, the PDF was prepared to make the transcript more accessible, with a prayer that Allah bless everyone involved. May Allah reward Muhammad Abdul Rahman, Shaykh Yasir Qadhi, and all those who contributed to recording, transcribing, and preparing this work. Readers who benefit from it are encouraged to make du‘a for them and their families.
